landing.tagline: AI-Powered Attendance Management for Rural Schools
landing.heroSubtitle: SmartAttend Rural helps schools replace paper attendance registers with a secure, AI-powered, offline-first attendance management system that connects teachers, administrators, and parents.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Designed specifically for schools with unstable internet, providing reliable offline operations and automated reports.
landing.feat1Desc: Teachers can record the daily roll call in seconds using a large-touch interface optimized for mobile screens.
landing.feat2Desc: Mark registers without electricity or network. Syncs to cloud database automatically when the connection is restored.
landing.feat3Desc: Sends immediate SMS/WhatsApp absence notifications to parents automatically when roll call is completed.
landing.feat4Desc: Generate and compile daily, monthly, or annual class attendance records as downloadable Excel and PDF files.
landing.feat5Desc: Visualize average attendance rates, watchlist students at risk, and class comparisons with Recharts diagrams.
landing.feat6Desc: Secure, dedicated workspaces with whitelisted credentials for Administrators, Classroom Teachers, and Parents.
landing.whySubtitle: Eliminate administrative lag, paper waste, and manual calculations.
landing.howSubtitle: Setting up and managing student attendance takes less than 3 minutes.
landing.step1Desc: Admin creates student profiles, class rosters, and teacher accounts in the dashboard.
landing.step2Desc: Teachers log in securely to access their assigned class directories.
landing.step3Desc: Teacher marks attendance in seconds. Submissions cache offline if connectivity drops.
landing.step4Desc: The cloud triggers alerts to parents immediately for absent students.
landing.rolesSubtitle: Separated workspaces customized to the responsibilities of each school user.
landing.roleAdminDesc: School Principal or administrator with complete administrative dashboard keys.
landing.roleTeacherDesc: Class faculty in charge of daily roster check-ins and standard registries.
landing.roleParentDesc: Linked family contacts tracking student attendance history records.
landing.aiSubtitle: We are preparing modular services to automatically summarize reports and predict absenteeism.
landing.ai1Desc: Analyzes student histories to flag students who are likely to skip classes in the next week.
landing.ai2Desc: Runs biometric verification on classroom group photos to cross-verify manual roll calls.
landing.ai3Desc: Parses database configurations to recommend mid-day meal audits and counseling.
landing.ai4Desc: Maintains machine learning weights in local IndexedDB registers to forecast standard trends offline.
landing.mockSubtitle: Explore preview mockups of the principal, teacher, and parent panels.
landing.audit1: Admin updated school settings timing parameters.
landing.audit2: Student record Jay Pawar linked to Suresh Patel.
landing.testSubtitle: Empowering educators, simplifying registers, and improving communication.
landing.quotePrincipal: This system reduced our daily attendance logging time from 15 minutes to less than 3 minutes per standard. The automatic parent SMS triggers have significantly reduced absenteeism.
landing.quoteTeacher: I was worried that an online database would fail because of village network cuts, but the offline IndexedDB cache stores everything perfectly until internet is restored.
landing.quoteParent: I receive an SMS alert immediately if Aarav is late or absent. It gives me peace of mind knowing the school tracks student check-ins so closely.
landing.faq1Q: Is internet connectivity required to mark attendance?
landing.faq1A: No, SmartAttend Rural is built offline-first. Teachers can mark daily attendance registers entirely offline. The data is cached locally inside the browser's IndexedDB and will automatically synchronize with the central MongoDB servers once the internet connection is restored.
landing.faq2Q: How do parents track their child's attendance?
landing.faq2A: Parents receive automated SMS or WhatsApp notifications immediately if their child is marked absent. Additionally, they can log in to their Parent Dashboard account to review monthly calendars, check-in status, and download reports.
landing.faq3Q: Can the school export attendance reports to Excel or PDF?
landing.faq3A: Yes, school administrators and teachers can generate custom monthly or daily attendance reports. These reports can be downloaded instantly as print-ready PDF files or Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx) for official record-keeping.
landing.faq4Q: Is student and teacher data secure?
landing.faq4A: Absolutely. All user communications are secured, passwords are encrypted using bcrypt hashing, and API endpoints are protected using JSON Web Token (JWT) role authorization checks to prevent unauthorized access.
landing.faq5Q: Can multiple schools use this system?
landing.faq5A: SmartAttend Rural is designed with a multi-tenant scalable architecture. In Version 1 it seeds data for a single model school standard, but it is modular and fully prepared to support district-wide and multi-school configurations in future releases.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Replace paper attendance registers with SmartAttend Rural today. Setting up takes less than 3 minutes.
landing.footerDesc: AI-Powered Attendance Management for Rural and Semi-Rural schools. Works offline, notifies parents.
landing.copyright: SmartAttend Rural. Designed to empower rural education through digital attendance.
